test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
The following question is based on the number series given below.

K 9 T I J D 2 5 U 8 V 1 B N E 4 3 Y O C

If all the vowels are dropped out from the above arrangement, which element will be 8th from the left side?
solution:
Given series: Left side K 9 T I J D 2 5 U 8 V 1 B N E 4 3 Y O C Right side

If all the vowels are dropped out, then the new series will be:

Left side K 9 T J D 2 5 8 V 1 B N 4 3 Y C Right side

Hence, the 8th element from the left side is **8.**
